title: Diabetes education classes
what: Classes for people with diabetes and their family. A doctor or nurse teaches you how to live with diabetes and manage your sugar.
why: When diabetes was just found, when insulin was prescribed, or when sugar is hard to keep steady.
duration: usually several classes of 1 to 2 hours
tell_doctor: What type of diabetes you have and for how long
Which medicines or insulin you get
If you have trouble seeing or hearing, a suitable format will be arranged

prepare.title: Signing up
prepare.text: Ask your doctor or clinic where the classes are held and how to sign up.

prepare.title: Questions
prepare.text: Write down in advance what you do not understand. They will be answered in class.

prepare.title: Family
prepare.text: You can come with a relative who helps you at home.

bring: A glucose meter and sugar diary
A snack in case of low sugar
steps: You come to a group or a one-on-one class
You are told what diabetes is and how sugar works
You learn to measure sugar and keep a diary
You hear about food and carbohydrate counting
You learn what to do with low and high sugar
You are told about foot care and check-ups with doctors
feel: There is a lot of new information, which is normal, and it comes in parts
after: Start applying what you understood, little by little
Write down your sugar and show the diary to your doctor
If something is forgotten, you can come again, so check with the clinic

faq.q: Do I need classes if I have been ill for a long time?
faq.a: Yes, they are useful. Methods and devices change, and many people learn something new.
It depends on the clinic and insurance. Check with the clinic.

reminders.text: Diabetes class tomorrow. Bring your glucose meter, diary, and a snack.
